summary: Checklist for reviewing a collection before publishing: run playbooks using it, proofread docs, ensure the version is higher than the latest published one, and rebuild after fixes.
questions: What should I verify before publishing a new collection version?
How do I make sure my new version number will be accepted?

answer_card.title: Review a collection before publishing
answer_card.answer_md:
- Run a playbook using its modules and plugins and confirm new features work.
- Check docs for typos.
- Make sure the version is **higher** than the latest on the server.
- Fix issues and rebuild the tarball.
